criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact handoff needs into coverage output
avoid unsupported market-demand inference from generic keyword matching
keep missing capability evidence visible as unsupported

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the supplied needs handoff records and maps only exact need strings present in capabilities to direct coverage; unsupported needs remain explicitly unsupported. No generic or unrelated matches are visible in the supplied package.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before directly covered needs
use upstream provenance rank as within-group ordering key
avoid treating repeated or background-derived history as independent demand corroboration

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs ahead of direct coverage and uses the supplied provenance rank within each group. The output keeps unsupported records visible rather than converting them into covered demand claims.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from first ranked priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the bounded priority window and constructs the recommendation directly from the first already-ranked priority record. The final top_need and prioritize decision match the deterministic expected output.
